#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Measure peak RSS of compile and stream for the maximum-size program."""
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable
D="/app/tmp/work/perf"

code = r'''
import resource, subprocess, sys, os
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "%s"] + sys.argv[1:],
                   stdin=open(sys.argv[0] and "/dev/stdin","rb") if False else None)
'''

def peak(cmd, stdin_path=None, stdout_path=os.devnull):
    pre = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    with open(stdin_path or os.devnull, "rb") as fi, open(stdout_path, "wb") as fo:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=fi, stdout=fo)
    post = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    return p.returncode, max(post, pre) / 1024.0

rc, mb = peak([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], D + "/maxrules.cfg", D + "/tmp.prog")
print("compile maxrules rc=%s peak_child_rss=%.1f MiB" % (rc, mb))
rc, mb = peak([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", D + "/maxrules.prog"], D + "/maxrules.req")
print("stream maxrules rc=%s peak_child_rss=%.1f MiB" % (rc, mb))
rc, mb = peak([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", D + "/manyflows.prog"], D + "/manyflows.req")
print("stream manyflows rc=%s peak_child_rss=%.1f MiB" % (rc, mb))
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && cp perf/maxrules.cfg perf/maxrules.cfg 2>/dev/null; ls perf/ | head; timeout 300 python3 mem.py
